Panda Mini gaming case 3050/4060/5050/5060

https://makerworld.com/de/models/1830521-panda-mini-gaming-case-3050-4060-5050-5060?from=search#profileId-1954846

Mini Cube case for mini itx motherboard and low profile Nvidia Cards. support for HD plex 250w psu.

Best Printed in PETG with tree support. 0.20 Use noctua low profile cpu cooler…. Designed for 3mm self tapping screws.

Good finish if you print the side panels on a Carbon fibre or similar build plate. Model shown was printed on a Bambu A1

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Filament: PETG (#FFFFFF)
